title: dissector/btl2cap: Improved parsing of the l2cap control field format
description:
This commit adds parsing for four control fields: I-frame Enhanced Control
Field format, I-frame Extended Control Field format, S-frame Enhanced Control
Field format, and S-frame Extended Control Field format.

pcap sample file: [bt_l2cap_sample.pcapng](/uploads/3be5372e12a287a1b1fab514a21824c6/bt_l2cap_sample.pcapng)

notes.body:
Clang builder is not happy :

`packet-btl2cap.c:2575:20: error: variable 'ti_control' is used uninitialized whenever 'if' condition is false [clang-diagnostic-sometimes-uninitialized]`

added 1 commit
  • d29a950c - dissector/btl2cap: Improved parsing of the l2cap control field format
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/21493/diffs?diff_id=1506695690&start_sha=ea31602bb7201446b9c2ff8b136e08ed5973db3e)
I would consider playing with proto_tree_add_bitmask (and related functions), so you can get some of this formatting "for free".
There is certainly a lot more logic here than above, but proto_tree_add_bitmask could also work here.
Overall, I think this patch would benefit from proto_tree_add_bitmask (it would certainly address the Clang issue @alagoutte pointed out.
Good idea, I have modified it to the proto_tree_add_bitmask interface
